blaze.definition:
n. a strong flame that burns brightly
n. a light-colored marking
v. shine brightly and intensively
v. burn brightly and intensely
blaze.translation:
n. 火焰, 烈火, 光辉
vi. 燃烧, 发光
vt. 使燃烧, 宣布, 在树皮上刻痕

blaze a trail.translation: 开辟道路, 在树上作记号指路

blaze off.translation: 连续发射;大声叫嚷,慷慨激昂地说

blazed.translation: v. 猛烈地燃烧( blaze的过去式和过去分词 ); 发光, 照耀

blazer.definition: n. lightweight single-breasted jacket; often striped in the colors of a club or school
blazer.translation: n. 燃烧体, 颜色鲜明的上装, 宣布者

blazered.definition:
past tense of blazer
n. lightweight single-breasted jacket; often striped in the colors of a club or school
blazered.translation: (blazer 的过去时) n. 燃烧体, 颜色鲜明的上装, 宣布者

blazers.definition: n. lightweight single-breasted jacket; often striped in the colors of a club or school
blazers.translation: n. 宽松运动外衣( blazer的复数形式 )

blazes.definition:
n a strong flame that burns brightly
n a cause of difficulty and suffering
n noisy and unrestrained mischief
n a light within the field of vision that is brighter than the brightness to which the eyes are adapted
n a light-colored marking
v shine brightly and intensively
v shoot rapidly and repeatedly
v burn brightly and intensely
v move rapidly and as if blazing
v indicate by marking trees with blazes
blazes.translation:
n. <俚>地狱; 火焰( blaze的名词复数 ); 光辉; 迸发; （光或色彩等的）展现
v. 猛烈地燃烧( blaze的第三人称单数 ); 发光, 照耀

blazing.translation: a. 炽燃的, 强烈的

blazon.definition:
n the official symbols of a family, state, etc.
v decorate with heraldic arms
blazon.translation:
vt. 装饰, 宣布
n. 纹章

blazoned.translation: v. 广布( blazon的过去式和过去分词 ); 宣布; 夸示; 装饰

blazoner.definition:
n. One who gives publicity, proclaims, or blazons; esp., one
   who blazons coats of arms; a herald.

blazoning.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Blazon
blazoning.translation: v. 广布( blazon的现在分词 ); 宣布; 夸示; 装饰

blazonment.definition: n. The act of blazoning; blazoning; emblazonment.
blazonment.translation: n. 纹章解说, 纹章装饰, 公布

blazonry.definition: n the official symbols of a family, state, etc.
blazonry.translation: 解释(绘制)纹章的艺术,炫示

blazons.definition:
n the official symbols of a family, state, etc.
v decorate with heraldic arms
blazons.translation: v. 广布( blazon的第三人称单数 ); 宣布; 夸示; 装饰
